{{Quote|Jedi business, go back to your drinks.|Anakin Skywalker, to Zey Nep and other clubgoers|audio=Anakin-JediBusiness-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Zey Nep''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], was friends with [[Dixon Just]] and [[Civ Sila]], and was mentored by the archeologist [[Artuo Pratuhr]]. During a visit to the club with her mentor, Pratuhr dealt with the criminal [[Seib Nod]] for stolen relics from the [[Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance]] but had his [[Currency/Legends|money]] stolen by her. The archeologist later tracked down Nod at a dock intending to leave Coruscant. Nep jammed a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] into the criminal's back, making her realize defeat and return Pratuhr's money. 

==Biography==
===Pratuhr's Assistant===
[[File:Outlander_Club.png|thumb|right|350px|Zey Nep frequented the Outlander Club (pictured) on her homeworld.]]
Zey Nep was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who hailed from<ref name="zn" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was friends with<ref name="zn" /> fellow Humans<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Dixon Just]] and [[Civ Sila]],<ref name="zn" /> and she was an [[Aide/Legends|assistant]]<ref name="sn">{{DB|character|seibnod|Nod, Seib}}</ref> and mentee<ref name="zn" /> of [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Artuo Pratuhr]]. Prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="zn" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she patronized the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="zn" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref>

In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, therefore meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Nep, Pratuhr, and Sila visited the Outlander Club while the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] made preparations to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] there.<ref name="Jango">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> One [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC" /> shortly afterwards,<ref name="NEC" /> Zep visited the establishment again with Pratuhr and her two friends.<ref name="AOTC" /> Pratuhr had, prior to this visit, contacted the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] woman [[Seib Nod]], interested in buying stolen relics off her to sell to<ref name="sn" /> Coruscant's<ref name="Museum">{{CSWECite|I|310|Galactic Museum}}</ref> [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]].<ref name="sn" /> Wesell, having failed her assassination attempt, hid in the club during their visit as well.<ref name="AOTC" />

===Robbing and retrieval===
[[File:ZeyNep-AOTC.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Zey Nep and Artuo Pratuhr (center) walked by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.]]
When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered, searching for the bounty hunter, Nep, cup-in-hand, walked by the two with Pratuhr. The assistant and her mentor stayed behind the Jedi briefly before walking off to Just and Sila<ref name="AOTC" /> near a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].<ref name="CL" /> Her friends later separated from her and Pratuhr<ref name="AOTC" /> and debated,<ref name="Insider75">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> but rejoined them shortly before Kenobi slashed Wesell at the bar with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], drawing the group's attention. Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and left with Kenobi and the bounty hunter.<ref name="AOTC" />

Nep and Pratuhr then met with Nod at a private alcove in the club. Her mentor, suspicious over the deal, was lied to by the Lorrdian, who told him the [[Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance]], a religious group she was no longer apart of, was in need of funding. Nod actually had no intention to give Nep's mentor the relics and stole his [[Currency/Legends|money]] at [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] point before escaping. Pratuhr proceeded to use his underground connections to track the woman down, finding her at a dock attempting to flee offworld. The archaeologist made his presence known to Nod before Nep, disguised as a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]], jammed a blaster into her back. After seeing Nep, Nod realized defeat and returned the money. The Lorrdian was taken to the authorities by Pratuhr, who also gave back the relics to the sisterhood.<ref name="sn" />

==Personality and traits==
Nep was friends with Dixon Just and Civ Sila, often being found in the company of them and Pratuhr. She had light skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="zn" /> worn in a large, upright cone shape.<ref name="AOTC" /> "Zey" was a feminine first name of Human origin.<ref name="GalacitcCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
While at the Outlander Club, Nep wore a<ref name="AOTC" /> black and gray<ref name="Club Zed">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/10/imageattack20021029.html|series=Image Attack|text=Club Zed}}</ref> [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] and heels.<ref name="AOTC" /> She used a blaster and was dressed as a refugee at the dock.<ref name="sn" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Zeynup's appropriately named character can be seen strolling through the frame with Don Bies during an exchange between Anakin and Obi-Wan.|[[Daniel Wallace]]|<ref name="Insider75" />}}
[[File:ZeyNep-ATBP.png|thumb|right|300px|Zey Nep was portrayed by Zeynep Selcuk (right).]]
Zey Nep appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> where the character was portrayed by [[Zeynep Selcuk]]<ref name="Insider75" /> during the Outlander Club scenes<ref name="AOTC" /> shot on [[July 17]], [[2000]], at [[Fox Studios, Sydney|Fox Studios, Syndey]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Selcuk was a member of the film's Droid Unit<ref name="Insider75" /> and also operated the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] in the film.<ref name="R4">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|18|Droids, Aliens & Creatures}}</ref> Nep was first pictured in the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]],<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> and first appeared in an illustration in ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', a young readers book written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]]<ref name="Jango" /> that was published on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> The image of her in the book<ref name="Jango" /> was taken from the then-upcoming film,<ref name="AOTC" /> released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref>

Nep was first identified through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Image Attack]] feature on [[October 29]], 2002.<ref name="Club Zed" /> The spelling "Zey Nup" was used in the "[[Droids, Aliens & Creatures]]" department of the [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 18|eighteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection]]'' magazine,<ref name="R4" /> written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="V-Credits">{{EmailCite|email=File:HCSV-Email-2025-07-26.png|author=[[Iain Lowson]]|date=2025-07-26}}</ref> and published around [[May 21]], [[2009]].<ref name="Date">{{OSVCdates|18}}</ref>
